S64.01.needs: A paired Chrome browser with the AGI extension and a page open in Chrome
S64.01.note: The dialog shows the page text, but the code did not show that a question typed afterwards is answered from it.
steps: Sign in, open a chat, and pair Chrome with the AGI extension if it is not paired yet.
Open a web page in Chrome and keep it as the active tab.
Click the + button in the message box, then click Use the browser.
Click Read the page and read the address, title and text shown in the Recent activity area and the transcript box.
Compare the shown title and address with the page open in Chrome.
S64.01.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > Read the page

S64.02.needs: Chrome with the AGI extension and an approved site
S64.02.note: The Chrome-side entries were found; the handoff into the Desktop chat was traced only as far as the bridge server.
steps: In Chrome, open a site the user has approved in the AGI extension.
Select a sentence or paragraph of text on the page.
Right-click the selection and click Explain this.
Or open the AGI side panel, click its + button and click Add selected text.
Look in the AGI chat for the selected text sent as context and the question asked about it.
S64.02.where: Chrome: highlight text on an approved site > right-click the selection > Explain this, or open the AGI side panel > + > Add selected text

S64.05.needs: A paired Chrome browser with a page open
S64.05.note: No button named Summarize was found; the closest is Read the page in Use the browser, whose description mentions summarizing, and the summary request is typed in chat.

S64.06.needs: A paired Chrome browser with the AGI extension and a page open in Chrome
S64.06.note: Whether the page text reaches the chat answer was not traced end to end.
steps: Pair Chrome with the AGI extension and open a page in Chrome.
Click the + button in the message box, then click Use the browser.
Click Read the page to load the current page.
Type a question about the page in the chat box and send it.
Check that the answer uses facts from the page that is open in Chrome.
S64.06.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > Read the page, then type the question in the chat box

S64.10.needs: A paired Chrome browser with the AGI extension
S64.10.note: The dialog's action button label was not found by name; it was not confirmed.
steps: Click the + button in the message box, then click Use the browser.
Choose Open a page.
Type https://example.com in the field labelled Address.
Send the action with the dialog's action button.
Look in Chrome for the new address opened in the active tab.
S64.10.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > Open a page

S64.11.needs: Desktop app with a coding session and a Browser panel
S64.11.note: The known gap holds: the assistant has no reload command, and how the Browser panel is opened from the session was not traced.
steps: Open a coding session that shows the Browser panel and load two pages in it.
Click Back and check that the previous page loads.
Click Forward and check that the next page loads again.
Click Reload and check that the current page reloads.
Check that Back and Forward are greyed out when there is no history.
S64.11.where: Browser panel of a coding session (aria-label "Browser") > Back, Forward or Reload

S64.15.needs: A paired Chrome browser and a page with a form
S64.15.note: The tester must know a CSS selector; the dialog does not find fields by name.
steps: Pair Chrome and open a page with a form in Chrome.
Click the + button in the message box, then click Use the browser.
Click Read the page and note a field selector from the text shown.
Choose Type, enter the CSS selector in the field labelled CSS selector and the value in Text, then send.
Look in Chrome to see the text typed into that field.
S64.15.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > Type

S64.18.needs: A paired Chrome browser with the AGI extension
S64.18.note: The list is shown only while the dialog is open, and it resets when Desktop restarts.
steps: Pair Chrome, then open Use the browser from the + button.
Run Read the page or Open a page.
Look at the Recent activity list in the dialog.
Check that the new entry shows the command name and its status: running, then done or failed.
S64.18.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > Recent activity

S64.26.needs: A paired Chrome browser and a file address to download
S64.26.note: The Downloads section appears only after a download succeeds; an approval step before download was not found in this file.
steps: Pair Chrome, open Use the browser, and choose Download a file.
Type the address of a file in the field labelled Address and send it.
Look for the Downloads section listing the downloaded file name.
Click Open Downloads folder and check the file is there.
S64.26.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > Download a file > Downloads section

S64.30.needs: Desktop app (the section is hidden on the web)
S64.30.note: The settings nav label is taken from the section heading Browser, which was not separately confirmed in the navigation file.
steps: In the Desktop app, open Settings and go to the Browser section.
Click Clear browsing data.
Read the confirmation titled Clear browsing data? and click Clear.
Look for the message Browsing data cleared.
Open a site that needed sign-in in the browser pane and check that you are signed out.
S64.30.where: Settings > Browser > Clear browsing data > Clear

labels.text: That browser action did not run.

S64.32.needs: A paired Chrome browser with the AGI extension
S64.32.note: The code shows the result and the activity status, but a written chat summary of what remains for the user was not confirmed in the dialog.
steps: Pair Chrome, open Use the browser, and run an action such as Read the page.
Read the result text shown above Recent activity.
Read the Recent activity entries for the outcome: done, or failed with a message.
If an action fails, look for the message That browser action did not run.
S64.32.where: Chat composer > the + button (aria-label "More composer options") > Use the browser > run an action > result text above Recent activity
